# create transform filling rectangular monochrome borders, choose 7 for odd interior side, 2 even
code='''def transform(grid):\n    g=[row[:] for row in grid]\n    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])\n    seen=set()\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            color=g[r][c]\n            if (r,c) in seen or color==g[0][0]: continue\n            # connected component of non-background same color\n            stack=[(r,c)]; comp=set(); seen.add((r,c))\n            while stack:\n                y,x=stack.pop(); comp.add((y,x))\n                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):\n                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx\n                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx]==color:\n                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))\n            rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]\n            a,b=min(rs),max(rs); l,q=min(cs),max(cs)\n            if len(comp)==2*((b-a+1)+(q-l+1))-4 and all((y,x) in comp for y in (a,b) for x in range(l,q+1)) and all((y,x) in comp for x in (l,q) for y in range(a,b+1)):\n                fill=7 if (b-a-1)%2 else 2\n                for y in range(a+1,b):\n                    for x in range(l+1,q): g[y][x]=fill\n    return g\n'''
